answer: Each agent earns a reputation token called Nectar that matures like a nebula’s slow expansion: age adds weight to its Atlas‑recorded stake. When an identity signs up, it must lock a proportional amount of PoA collateral and prove continuous activity; inactivity triggers exponential decay of its Nectar score, erasing the stake. An attacker must fund dozens of fresh accounts with full collateral and sustain ongoing activity, making a Sybil breach cost proportional to locked value.
